item.title: America Against Itself: A Democracy Resisting Its Own Fascist Leader
item.description: The United States has entered a strange intermediate condition: a genuinely free country governed by a clique with dictatorial ambitions. Unlike disarmed Russia, America still has courts, states, a free press, and an armed citizenry — which is why the outcome of this fight is genuinely open.

item.title: There Is No Perfect Constitution: Why Systems Must Fit Their Societies
item.description: A reflection on why no electoral system, state structure, or constitution is universally ideal: universal principles are real, but the deep question is always how far a society's socio-cultural base contradicts its institutions. One size fits no one.
